welcome_message:
PySpark Test Runner: Asset Installer

Installs a single-file Python wrapper around `pytest` for local PySpark
suites, packaged as an agentskills.io-style skill: SKILL.md describes when
and how to use it, scripts/run-pyspark-tests.py runs the tests.

The wrapper runs pytest, writes the full output to a log file, and prints
only a bounded digest built from the JUnit XML: exit code, counts, runnable
failing node ids, and failures deduplicated by signature. A suite where many
tests fail with the same error collapses to one short block instead of
flooding a coding agent's context window.

The wrapper adds no dependencies of its own (Python 3.9+, standard
library), but it runs your suite, so pytest and PySpark must be installed
in the project interpreter. Local pytest only: no Databricks workspace,
deploy, or run.

Let's pick the install path...

target_dir.description:
Target directory for the skill (relative to your bundle root).
Defaults to `.agents`, which matches the convention used by Codex,
the Databricks AI Dev Kit, and any vendor-neutral multi-agent setup.
Files install at <target_dir>/skills/pyspark-test-runner/SKILL.md and
<target_dir>/skills/pyspark-test-runner/scripts/run-pyspark-tests.py.

If you only use one agent and want auto-discovery, override with the
agent's native folder:
  - Claude Code:  .claude
  - Codex:        .codex
  - Cursor:       .cursor
  - Gemini CLI:   .gemini

Pick a path whose `skills/pyspark-test-runner/` subfolder doesn't already
exist in your project.

target_dir.pattern_match_failure_message: Target directory must start with a letter, number, underscore, or dot and contain only letters, numbers, underscores, slashes, hyphens, or dots.

success_message:
========================================

Skill installed at '{{.target_dir}}/skills/pyspark-test-runner/'.

Next steps:

1. Wire the skill into your agent. Pick the line that matches your setup:

   Claude Code
   - Auto-discovery folder is `.claude/skills/`. If you installed to `.claude` directly, you're done.
   - Otherwise add to CLAUDE.md:
     > Use the skill at {{.target_dir}}/skills/pyspark-test-runner/SKILL.md when running local PySpark pytest suites.

   Codex
   - Add to AGENTS.md:
     > Use the skill at {{.target_dir}}/skills/pyspark-test-runner/SKILL.md for local PySpark tests. Invoke `python {{.target_dir}}/skills/pyspark-test-runner/scripts/run-pyspark-tests.py "<node-id>" -x`.

   Cursor
   - Cursor does NOT auto-discover `.cursor/skills/`. Drop a rule at `.cursor/rules/pyspark-test-runner.mdc` pointing at the SKILL.md.

   Gemini CLI
   - Reference {{.target_dir}}/skills/pyspark-test-runner/SKILL.md from your `.gemini/` configuration.

   Other / multi-agent
   - Point your agent at {{.target_dir}}/skills/pyspark-test-runner/SKILL.md however your runtime expects.

2. Smoke check the wrapper against your suite (run from your project root):
   python {{.target_dir}}/skills/pyspark-test-runner/scripts/run-pyspark-tests.py tests/ -x

   Requires pytest and PySpark installed in the project (or pass --python at
   an interpreter that has them). The wrapper writes logs to
   <project-root>/.pyspark-test-logs/ by default; add that to .gitignore.
